about: Every public filing the pipeline reads, oldest first. The newest filing per utility is current; earlier ones give schedule history and the change log. The alert worker appends new filings here when it finds them.

ga.note: Georgia's annual transmission update has been filed in the IRP docket; a new IRP opens a new docket, which has to be added here.
